globals.name: lbl_801FDA00
globals.role: follower object tracking the player (camera target / scene helper); +0x14 position mirrors Wario but is rewritten each frame - use G-0007 for the player
globals.evidence: In-run MEM1 snapshots (private/runs/20261026T165304735180Z-f5082ae1): pointer 0x801FDA00 -> 0x804AF400 in Greenhorn Forest; +0x14 vec3 moved (-111.8,10.6,-36.6) -> (-270.6,11.4,-85.1) during a 2 s forward walk and +28 in x during a right walk with near-constant y. The camera init fn_80068250 calls this object's vtable slot +8 with camera block +0x94 (likely 'get position/target').
globals.notes: Heap address varies per load; always go through the pointer. Second walk moved only ~6 units (likely blocked) - recheck with more samples.
